instruction: Access the Master Slides mode from the View menu, click on the slide number placeholder text, and set the font size to 24 points using the size selector in the toolbar

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate to master slides view and change the slide number font size to 24 points (2400 in hundredths of a point). The evaluator verifies the font size by parsing the slide master XML and checking for the sz attribute in the text run properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts PPTX file from VM using get_vm_file getter
Metric function check_page_number_font_size_24__3fddd8a3 correctly parses PPTX XML structure as a ZIP archive
Logic correctly navigates to slideMaster1.xml and searches for slide number placeholder (ph_type='sldNum')
Font size check correctly examines both a:rPr and a:defRPr elements for sz attribute
Expected value 2400 is semantically correct (24 points = 2400 in hundredths of a point)
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Complete coverage: verifies the specific requirement stated in instruction (font size of slide number set to 24 points)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Metric returns 1.0 on first match without verifying this is the only font size in the placeholder, though this is typically acceptable for master slide placeholders with uniform formatting
